items.text:
I did not enjoy the character creation process. I want to pick my traits and have a balanced non-randomized start.

I enjoyed the character creation in NEO Scavenger much more.
items.text_zh:
我不喜欢角色创建过程。我想选择我的特质，并拥有一个平衡的、非随机的开局。

我更喜欢《NEO Scavenger》中的角色创建。

observations.description: 角色创建过程随机化，无法选择特质和平衡开局
observations.evidence: I want to pick my traits and have a balanced non-randomized start.
observations.evidence_zh: 我想自己挑选特质，并拥有一个平衡的、非随机的开局。
